module: Flowgraph node "Set Timer Property" (category repeat_instant). Modifies an existing timer: progress (elapsed time in s), pause, duration, ref (mode). Only properties whose pin is not nil are changed.
notes: duration and ref have default values (5, dtSim): with no connected pin they are therefore rewritten every frame.

postInit.desc: Defines the preset values of the ref pin.

work.desc: Applies progress, pause, duration and ref to the timer via the timer module.
